incline-press.criteria: 45-degree incline bench; supported back/head and planted feet; overhand barbell grip slightly outside shoulder width; controlled press above upper chest.

upright-row.criteria: Standing barbell with overhand shoulder-width grip; elbows lead outwards, finish below shoulder height; fixed trunk and feet.

wrist-curl.criteria: Seated with forearms resting on thighs and wrists beyond knees; palms up, move through wrist flexion/extension while forearms remain fixed.

limits: Reused procedural human/bench rig with new exercise IDs, camera and timing, adjusted press/row grip width. Simplified anatomy and equipment. Sampled checks do not certify all mesh collision or biomechanics; physical device and production pending.
